knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. State Bayes' theorem connecting prior, likelihood, and posterior for an event/parameter in words.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Posterior ∝ prior × likelihood (normalised). Bayes updates beliefs given data.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 5.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Refuse: treating P(disease|positive) as equal to P(positive|disease) without calculation. What does Bayes require?
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse inverse confusion. Bayes combines prior (base rate) with likelihood of the data; the two conditionals are not equal.
